data.title: Regent Residences
data.about:
Regent Residences Dubai Sankari Place at Business Bay is a luxury development by Sankari Properties and Regent, located next to the Dubai Water Canal. The complex has two 37-storey towers, offering 63 exclusive residences, each with a private lift lobby. Property at Regent Residences includes 3 and 4-bedroom apartments, 5-bedroom penthouses, and 10 waterfront villas.

The luxury residences at The Regent Residences feature private temperature-controlled pools and optional jacuzzis or garages. Other amenities include a cigar lounge, spa, wine cellar, golf simulator, and more. Residents also enjoy a gym, yoga studio, and various play areas. The a la carte services offer complete convenience, including chauffeur-driven limousines and chef services.

characteristics_module.title: Branded Residences by Regent Hotels and Resorts
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Regent Residences Dubai Sankari Place is located in Business Bay, offering easy access to Dubai’s business and leisure hubs. 
  • Exclusive Residences: Regent Residences includes 3 and 4-bedroom apartments, 5-bedroom penthouses, and ultra-penthouses with private lift lobbies. 
  • Luxury Amenities: The Regent Residences' luxury residences feature private, temperature-controlled pools, a cigar lounge, a spa, a wine cellar, and a gym. 
  • Waterfront Villas: The complex also offers 10 waterfront villas with private pools and jacuzzis, providing exclusive living by the Dubai Water Canal. 
  • First-Class Services: Regent Residences offers a la carte services that include chauffeur-driven limousines, housekeeping, chef services, and fitness trainers for unmatched convenience. 
  • Premium Design: The floor plans of Regent Residences Dubai Sankari Place offer spacious layouts with luxurious interiors designed for comfort and elegance.

location_tile.title: An Address at the Heart of Exclusive Waterfront Living
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Regent Residences Dubai Sankari Place is located in the heart of Business Bay, making it ideal for professionals and entrepreneurs. The complex is surrounded by luxury hotels like Radisson Blu and Paramount, offering residents access to world-class dining and spa services. Nearby developments, including The Lana Residences, add to the area’s appeal and potential property value growth. Regent Residences by Sankari Properties offers luxury living with premium amenities and an unbeatable location in Dubai’s business district.

  • 10 Minutes to Downtown Dubai 
  • 15 Minutes to Al Maktoum Airport 
  • 30 Minutes to Dubai Marina 
  • 45 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
